page.overview:
Who is Clarimonde Udolpho?

Clarimonde Udolpho is a member of the House of Udolpho, a Tilean noble house with an estate of the same name in the Principality of Miragliano.

Clarimonde is the wife and cousin of Ambrosio Udolpho. She was purportedly kidnapped by bandits. She left her husband with their daughter who seems to not be affected by the Curse of Udolpho.
